upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Additive over 0.9.0-rc.16: the client subset stays at 116 operations; the full specification grows from 382 to 385 with POST /admin/processing/probe/versions/{id}/run, POST /admin/processing/probe/jobs/{id}/retry and POST /admin/sources/{id}/processing/probe/reset (ProcessingProbeRun, ProcessingProbeRunResponse, ProcessingProbeResult, ProcessingProbeSourceReset). Media adds the required best_version (nullable BestVersion: id, resolution, width, height, hdr_type, bitrate_bps and dolby_vision_profile of the first entry of GET /media/{id}/versions; measured facts only) and version_count. PreparedPlayback adds the required technical_probe (not_needed, started, busy, unsupported): preparing an unknown version starts a stored background MediaInfo probe. Preload detection reads the User-Agent purpose products Streamix-Play and Streamix-Preload, falling back to Sec-Purpose: prefetch; a preload stream takes no concurrent-stream slot, a preload progress report returns 409 prefetch_not_recorded, and while the site setting prefetch_enabled is false every preload returns 403 prefetch_disabled (403 responses gain that description). Capability features add media_best_version, playback_technical_probe, prefetch, prefetch_user_agent_purpose, prefetch_stream_limit_exempt and administration_processing_probe_commands; no new limits. No typed SDK schema change: the typed Media and PlaybackSession read only their existing fields.
